status_note: DRAFT for owner review. The eight conditions are the owner's (verbatim below). The artifact paths, file names, required fields, accepted status values and required coverage sets that make each condition machine-checkable are PROPOSED by this lane; the owner may change them. Nothing here is decided, pre-registered or locked. This file is read by scripts/experiments/s1_readiness.py; it is not a threshold register and contains no physical, efficiency or RFP number.

authority.rule: The gate evaluates only while the owner disposition that created it exists and is APPROVED; otherwise the verdict is S1_NOT_READY with an authority item.

gate_semantics.rule: S1_READY only if the authority holds and every one of the eight conditions is SATISFIED. Otherwise S1_NOT_READY, listing every unsatisfied condition with its expected artifact(s), the failed checks and the producer.

condition_states.SATISFIED: an artifact exists at an expected path and passes every rule
condition_states.MISSING: no artifact exists at any expected path
condition_states.REJECTED_DRAFT: a 'status' or 'decision' field ANYWHERE in the artifact (top level or nested, e.g. one LOCK-1 decision, one hardware item or one feed point) contains DRAFT, PROPOSED or PENDING; such an artifact never satisfies a condition, whatever else it contains. The feed-point flight-status 'label' is not a status field.
condition_states.INVALID: the artifact exists but fails one or more rules (the failures are listed)
condition_states.AMBIGUOUS: an artifact exists at more than one candidate location (the gate never chooses between them)

availability.PARTIAL_PRECURSORS_ONLY: one or more precursor drafts exist in the repository; precursors are reported for orientation and NEVER satisfy a condition

never: infer or fill a condition by assumption
accept a DRAFT, PROPOSED or PENDING artifact
accept a design analysis in place of a demonstration from actual calibration measurements (condition S1-C4)
read an artifact outside the repository or follow a reference outside it
gate_semantics.date_format: decided/approved/calibration dates: ISO 8601 calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, optionally followed by THH:MM[:SS]Z (UTC); the date and time must exist (e.g. 2026-13-45 is rejected)
gate_semantics.sha256_ref_format: an object {"path": <repository-relative path>, "sha256": <64 lowercase hex>}; the gate recomputes the sha256 of the file on disk and requires equality
gate_semantics.draft_status_scope: recursive: every object at every depth, including list items

rule_types.is_true: field is the JSON boolean true
rule_types.iso_date: field is a valid (existing) date in the gate's date_format
rule_types.nonempty_string: field is a non-empty string that does not start with 'TBD' (case-insensitive)
rule_types.sha256_ref: field is a sha256 reference to a file inside the repository whose sha256 matches; optional path_equals pins the path; optional artifact_of pins it to the resolved artifact of another condition (the chain LOCK-1 -> S1 records); optional path_prefix requires the referenced file to lie under that repository directory
rule_types.decisions_decided: field is a list of objects covering every id in ids, each with a non-empty, non-TBD choice_key that contains no DRAFT/PROPOSED/PENDING token; optional choice_pattern (with {id} replaced by the decision id) must match the choice in full
rule_types.location_choice: the directory of the resolved artifact equals map[choice] where choice is the choice_key of decision decision_id in decisions_field
rule_types.covers: field is a list of objects whose key values include every value in required
rule_types.each_item: field is a non-empty list and every item passes rules
rule_types.any_item: field is a non-empty list and at least one item passes rules
rule_types.quantity: field is an object {value, unit, source, evidence_class}: value a number or an object of numbers (e.g. species fractions), unit and source non-empty strings not starting with TBD, evidence_class one of measured / digitized / inferred / reconstructed / model-derived / assumed (docs/EVIDENCE.md)
rule_types.field_paths: a field may be a dotted path into nested objects (e.g. facility.name)

milestones.A: Scheduling precondition only: S1 -> LOCK-2 -> the controlled HW-0 / HW-RF / HW-ECR experiment is where the conditions of a conditional selection ('X is baseline provided ... are demonstrated') get demonstrated. The gate selects nothing.
milestones.B: Physics-backed selection needs measured common-condition performance and genuinely new held-out validation evidence; S1 is the qualification that makes those readings admissible (LOCK-2 from measured S1 noise/calibration; C1 partition frozen before H-1 data).
milestones.to_next: B additionally needs: S1 executed and LOCK-2 filed; Phase 1-3 data; the W5 pre-registration frozen and scored; an admitted Hall transport closure (credible set is empty today). C additionally needs mass, power, thermal, life, startup, cathode and mission closure integrated.

compliance: no Hall transport closure, screening candidate or withdrawn 0-D number is read or used
no architecture is ranked, preferred or eliminated; S1 is qualification, not architecture selection
no physical, efficiency or threshold value is carried; required coverage sets are PROPOSED
P5 calibration nuisance is never a design variable, map axis or gate item
reads only files inside the repository; writes only when --out is given
